title: Self-Alignment with Instruction Backtranslation
authors_zh: Xian Li、Ping Yu、Chunting Zhou、Timo Schick、Omer Levy、Luke Zettlemoyer、Jason Weston、Mike Lewis（Meta AI）
paper_type_zh: 自生成指令数据与迭代指令微调研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究如何把未标注网页文本转化为可审计指令数据的读者。
one_line: Instruction backtranslation generates and curates instructions for web documents, then uses the resulting pairs for iterative instruction tuning.
指令回译为网页文本生成并筛选相应指令，再将保留的指令—文本对用于迭代式指令微调。
why: It makes the original web text the answer side of a synthetic training record and puts data generation and filtering inside the alignment loop.
inclusion_reason: Shows how unlabeled human-written text can be transformed into curated instruction-following records for iterative supervised training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Instruction tuning usually needs large collections of human-written instruction-response pairs or answers distilled from stronger proprietary models. Both routes constrain the supply, provenance, and independence of training data.

This work asks whether unlabeled human-written web text can become instruction-following supervision. Its aim is to construct a reusable record whose response is already high-quality human text and whose missing instruction is inferred and checked by a model.

指令微调通常需要大量人工编写的指令—回答对，或需要从更强的专有模型蒸馏回答。这两条路线都会限制训练数据的供给、来源可追溯性与独立性。

本文要问的是，未标注的人类网页文本能否变成指令遵循监督。其目标是构造一种可复用记录：回答端已经是高质量人类文本，缺失的指令则由模型推断并检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Instruction backtranslation reverses ordinary instruction generation. Instead of asking a model to answer an instruction, it takes an existing web document as the desired answer and asks a seed model to infer an instruction that would appropriately request that text.

The generated pair is then self-curated before training. This separates data construction into augmentation and selection: a document creates possible supervision, but only an instruction-document pair judged suitable becomes a fine-tuning example.

指令回译反转了普通的指令生成过程。它不要求模型回答一条指令，而是把现有网页文本视为理想回答，再让种子模型推断什么指令能够恰当地请求这段文本。

生成的配对随后会经过自我筛选。这将数据构造分为扩增和选择：文档只会产生候选监督，只有被判断合适的指令—文档对才会成为微调样本。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method begins with a small seed set to train a model that maps a response-like document to an instruction. It applies that model to a web corpus, then uses a separate instruction-following evaluator to assess the resulting instruction-document examples and filter weak pairs.

The retained pairs fine-tune a stronger LLaMA model. The paper repeats this process for two iterations, so later data labeling and curation are performed by an improved model rather than by the original seed system.

该方法先利用一个小型种子集训练模型，使其把类似回答的文档映射为指令。它将该模型应用于网页语料库，再用单独的指令遵循评估器检查得到的指令—文档样本，并过滤较弱的配对。

保留的配对用于微调更强的 LLaMA 模型。论文重复这一过程两轮，因此后续的数据标注和筛选由已经提升的模型完成，而不是始终由原始种子系统完成。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
After two iterations, the reported LLaMA model outperforms other LLaMA-based systems on the Alpaca leaderboard that do not rely on distillation data. This establishes that the constructed and curated pairs can provide useful instruction-following supervision.

The evidence concerns a particular seed set, web corpus, curation procedure, and leaderboard regime. It does not establish that automatically inferred instructions preserve every intended meaning of the source document or that web-derived data is safe for every deployment.

经过两轮迭代后，报告中的 LLaMA 模型在不依赖蒸馏数据的 LLaMA 系统中，于 Alpaca 排行榜上超过其他模型。这说明构造并筛选出的配对能够提供有用的指令遵循监督。

证据针对的是特定种子集、网页语料、筛选程序和排行榜设定。它并未证明自动推断的指令能保留来源文档的每一层含义，也未证明网页派生数据对所有部署都安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing self-instruction approaches commonly start from an instruction and synthesize an answer. Here, high-quality human text is the fixed side of the record, and the model synthesizes the instruction around it, which changes what is inherited from the web and what is generated.

The paper also treats curation as a necessary companion to augmentation. Its contribution is a pipeline in which synthetic prompt generation, model-based filtering, and later fine-tuning all determine whether an unlabeled document becomes a training example.

既有自指令方法通常从一条指令出发，再合成回答。这里，高质量人类文本是记录中固定的一侧，模型围绕它合成指令；这改变了哪些内容继承自网页、哪些内容由模型生成。

论文还将筛选视为扩增不可缺少的配套环节。它的贡献是一条流水线：合成提示生成、基于模型的过滤和后续微调共同决定一份未标注文档是否成为训练样本。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Generated instructions can misrepresent a document, and self-curation can systematically favor the seed model’s own style. Web data introduces quality, privacy, licensing, and contamination risks; iteration can improve labeling but can also magnify early selection bias unless corpus provenance and held-out evaluation are carefully controlled.
生成的指令可能歪曲文档含义，自我筛选也可能系统性偏好种子模型自己的风格。网页数据带来质量、隐私、许可证和污染风险；迭代能够改善标注，也可能放大早期选择偏差，除非严格控制语料来源和留出评测。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when answers are easier to source than instructions, such as curated documents, manuals, or human-authored explanations. It provides a concrete pattern for recording the source document, generated instruction, filter decision, and model iteration so the resulting instruction data is traceable.
当回答比指令更容易获得时，例如已有筛选的文档、手册或人类解释，可参考这项工作。它提供了记录来源文档、生成指令、过滤决定和模型迭代的具体模式，使最终的指令数据可追溯。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: When reproducing the pipeline, inspect the seed-data size, web-corpus provenance, instruction-generation prompt, evaluator and threshold, deduplication, and iteration boundary. Compare results with and without self-curation; the central question is not only how many examples are generated, but which generated records are trusted by the trainer.
复现该流水线时，应检查种子数据规模、网页语料来源、指令生成提示、评估器及阈值、去重方式和迭代边界。要比较有无自我筛选时的结果；核心问题不仅是生成了多少样本，更是训练器信任了哪些生成记录。
